kinds.near-workspaces-test: a Rust #[tokio::test] that deploys NEAR contracts in a near-workspaces sandbox and replays an attack

units.note: Replays the Lean model's shortest attack traces against the real vault contracts; every test asserts the replayed state against the model witness. No platform-published outcome.

excluded.reason: harness smoke test (proves near-workspaces works), not an exploit
formal models and witnesses, not tests; they are the input the replay test consumes
no near-workspaces PoC test; the self-audit is prose plus Kani harnesses and testnet demos
web e2e test, not a contract PoC

tier_notes.J: none found: no public NEAR contest or bounty publishes judge-grouped coded PoCs in a form this corpus could pin
tier_notes.X: exorcist's sandbox replay is the only runnable NEAR exploit test found in the search
